poses.caption: Sit with chest supported, holding parallel grips with arms forward
Open arms outward to shoulder level while keeping elbows softly bent and chest supported

jobs.detail: LEVER SEATED REVERSE FLY with PARALLEL NEUTRAL GRIP. REAR three-quarter camera shows posterior shoulders and both hands. Adult sits facing into reverse-fly station with CHEST against front vertical chest pad, feet flat floor, torso upright/stationary. Both hands grip VERTICAL handles, palms face each other, thumbs wrap. LEFT start arms reach forward around chest pad at shoulder level, elbows slightly bent. RIGHT spread SAME arms OUTWARD/BACK to sides at shoulder height, maintaining SAME slight elbow bend, shoulder blades retract; not a row, no elbow flexion, no torso lean. Stop upper arms approximately in plane of torso, no excessive shoulder extension. Simple machine has two SAME LENGTH rigid moving arms rotating around FIXED vertical axes above/front shoulders; handles always visibly connected. SAME frame/pivots/pad/seat/stack/base and camera in both panels. Both posterior DELTOID shoulder caps exposed RED only, traps/back/triceps/forearms grayscale, entire black shirt BLACK no red back. Entire wide-open arms/handles and all machine fit within each panel.
jobs.prompt: Correct ONLY LEFT START PANEL of this original project reverse fly so it is a shoulder reverse-fly, not a bent-elbow row. BOTH arms should reach FORWARD around front of chest pad with elbows NEARLY STRAIGHT, just15degrees flexion, same elbow bend as RIGHT endpoint. In left panel extend upper arms/forearms together toward the front of the machine, hands farther forward away from chest, adjust connected vertical grips and swinging lever angle to meet hands. Keep palms facing each other, thumbs wrapped. Chest stays against pad; torso, legs, seat, fixed frame/pivots unchanged. RIGHT panel stays unchanged, arms spread outward at shoulder height. Red on posterior deltoids only, rest grayscale, detailed exposed fibers. Opaque BLACK shirt and shorts fully wrap front/sides/back/seat/crotch. White background, entire machine/body within each panel, no text. Preserve original male/female identity of supplied image.
jobs.inspectionNote: Start correction visibly extends both arms forward with soft elbows, improving reverse-fly movement consistency. End arms spread with posterior deltoid highlights, opaque clothing and chest support retained. Moving lever/fixed-pivot connections across phases remain mechanically ambiguous and blocked for validation. Original retained; anatomy approval pending.

poses.caption: Stand with shoulders under pads and balls of feet supported, heels lowered
Rise onto balls of feet by lifting both heels while keeping knees softly straight

jobs.detail: LEVER STANDING CALF RAISE, SIDE three-quarter camera shows both heels and toes clearly. Stand straight in shoulder-pad calf machine, feet shoulder-width on edge of raised fixed FOOT BLOCK, balls of BOTH feet supported on block, heels extend beyond rear edge. Shoulders beneath two padded supports attached to lever resistance frame; hands grasp shoulder-height handles securely. Spine neutral, knees nearly straight but softly unlocked and UNCHANGED across phases. LEFT heels lowered below block top in controlled ankle dorsiflexion, balls/toes remain on block. RIGHT push through same balls of feet and plantarflex BOTH ankles to raise BOTH heels clearly above block top; WHOLE body/shoulder carriage rises together, same upright posture, no knee bending or toe reposition. Body proportion/leg lengths fixed, ONLY ankle angle changes. Shoulder pads remain contacting shoulders and connected lever rotates around same FIXED pivot; same weight-stack machine frame/base/footblock in both panels. Red highlights ONLY exposed posterior CALVES on both lower legs, other anatomy grayscale, whole shirt/shorts BLACK opaque. Both shoes and entire machine including overhead frame and footblock within panels with white margins.
jobs.prompt: Correct this original project male standing calf raise in TWO panels. Reframe both scenes slightly smaller to leave generous white space ABOVE head and whole machine. Keep SAME machine/frame/footblock/camera/body proportions across phases. Move balls of BOTH feet toward REAR EDGE of fixed block so only FOREFOOT is supported and heels extend BEYOND block edge (toward viewer). LEFT phase: both heels hang clearly BELOW top of block with ankles dorsiflexed; knees softly straight. RIGHT phase: plantarflex ankles, heels clearly ABOVE block top, balls stay at SAME fixed contact points. The ENTIRE upright body, hips, shoulders, head and shoulder pads must translate UP together by heel-rise height on right, with unchanged femur/tibia/body lengths and knee angles; not shortened legs. Top pressing lever rotates slightly UP around its SAME fixed hinge with body/pads. Hands keep holding handles. Red posterior calves only, other exposed anatomy detailed grayscale, torso fully opaque black shirt and shorts wrapping seat/crotch/sides. Preserve model, no text, no floating forefeet.
jobs.inspectionNote: Correction visibly lowers start heels beyond block edge, raises endpoint heels and translates upright body and shoulder pads upward. More head margin; detailed grayscale anatomy, red calves and full opaque clothing retained. Forefoot contact consistency, fixed leg proportions and lever resistance require qualified human review. Original retained; no anatomical approval.
